name: Lisbon
description: Vibrant coastal city known for its historic neighborhoods, incredible food scene, nightlife, and warm hospitality. A perfect blend of old-world charm and modern energy.

name: Mexico City
description: Massive, energetic metropolis with world-class food, rich cultural heritage, incredible nightlife, and authentic local experiences at every turn.

name: Bangkok
description: Dynamic city blending ancient temples, street food paradise, bustling markets, and vibrant nightlife. A sensory overload in the best way.

name: Barcelona
description: Mediterranean gem with stunning architecture, beach culture, legendary food and drink scene, and creative energy throughout.

name: Tokyo
description: Fascinating blend of ultra-modern and traditional, with unparalleled food culture, unique neighborhoods, and incredible attention to detail in everything.
